.darma-loader-tw-donut-progress { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size, 64px); height: var(--loader-size, 64px); border-radius: 9999px; background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color, #6366f1) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 60%, #000 61%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 60%, #000 61%); animation: darma-loader-tw-donut-progress-twDonut calc(var(--loader-speed, 1s) * 2.2) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes darma-loader-tw-donut-progress-twDonut { 0% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color, #6366f1) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); } 55%, 72% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color, #6366f1) 360deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 360deg); } 100% { background-image: conic-gradient(var(--loader-color, #6366f1) 0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, .28) 0deg); } }
